title: A map with a history of changes
description: The work continues on another device, and an earlier version can be brought back.

blocks.text: A map holds the course of your thinking. Losing a branch during sync means losing work that cannot always be reproduced from memory.

quote.text: as soon as I had landed and reconnected to the cellular network, the app decided to automatically download the last known version of my charts from the cloud and deleted 6 hours of work without even a prompt

blocks.text: Save local changes, show the state of the transfer and allow earlier versions to be opened. Leave conflicting edits for a comparison the person can follow.
Test working without a network on two devices. A backup is only useful together with a restore that can be reached and a clear choice of version.
